families.v1/relevant.1.instructions: Does answering the message need a tool of the family numbered 1?

criteria.true: Doing what the message asks calls for one of the family's tools: the work is done with such a tool, whether or not the message names the tool or the family.
criteria.false: The message can be answered without the family's tools: it only mentions the family's subject, needs other tools, or needs none.
